paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, 95% CL one-sided upper limit
notes: Paper presents a new measured (not projected) 95% CL upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from spectropolarimetry of magnetic white dwarfs at Lick and Keck Observatories. The best limit comes from SDSS J033320+000720 (Lick/Kast): |g_agamma| < 1.7e-12 GeV^-1, approximately mass-independent for m_a << 1e-6 eV; paper states validity for m_a <~ 2e-7 eV, encoded as a flat two-point bound spanning the Fig. 1 mass range floor (1e-14 eV) up to 2e-7 eV. Above this mass, the limit weakens (curve visible in Fig. 1 but no tabulated values available). This is an astrophysical photon-to-axion conversion bound with no dark matter density assumption. Other MWDs give weaker limits (4.2e-12, 5.7e-12, 1.0e-11, 1.6e-11 GeV^-1). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 41)) | Vision: Main result is the red curve for SDSS J033320+000720 (Kast/Lick).
